exclusions: Current third-party dashboards and data-derived interval estimates
Other-exchange rules or different-symbol schedules as BTCUSDT proof
Unrelated market commentary, trading examples and performance claims
Current instrument API metadata as a historical calendar
Nearest archive availability dates treated as exact requested-date captures
limitation: Search is bounded and nonexhaustive. Failure to locate an announcement is not evidence that no interval change occurred.
methods: Opened all three user leads and followed the linked official feature announcement.
Searched official notices for 2023/2024 BTCUSDT schedules, interval adjustments and temporary exceptions.
Used official GitHub commit metadata and immutable documentation revisions.
Queried bounded Internet Archive availability/CDX metadata and checked exact archived payload digests.
Used a non-BTC notice only to test scope and unsupported backwards inference.
